description: Update channel metadata (name, topic, capabilities). Owner only. Access mode is fixed at creation — recreate the channel to change it.

capabilities.description: Which modes are enabled: txt (text), voice (group voice), files (file attach), ptt (push-to-talk), live (live stream). Voice/PTT/live are server-relayed via LiveKit — NOT end-to-end encrypted.

channel_id.description: Channel id (UUID). Use mIRC_list to discover available channels.

name: mIRC_update
